title: Ha Noi Cultural Day Trip
summary: Experience a full day of culture, history, and local traditions with Vietlook Travel . This private journey takes you from bustling Hanoi to three of the region’s most charming heritage sites.
inclusions: Lunch at Duong Lam Ancient Village
html:
Experience a full day of culture, history, and local traditions with Vietlook Travel. This private journey takes you from bustling Hanoi to three of the region’s most charming heritage sites.

Itinerary

08:00 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your private car and knowledgeable local guide will meet you at your accommodation in Hanoi to begin the day.

09:30 – Van Phuc Silk Village

Visit Vietnam’s best-known silk-producing village. Learn about the traditional weaving process, observe artisans crafting intricate silk products, and explore a wide selection of high-quality handmade items.

11:00 – Thay Pagoda

Continue to Thay Pagoda, one of the most peaceful and spiritually significant pagodas in northern Vietnam. Surrounded by mountains and tranquil lakes, it offers a picturesque setting and insight into Vietnam’s Buddhist heritage.

12:30 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese meal prepared with fresh, seasonal ingredients.

14:00 – Duong Lam Ancient Village

Step back in time as you explore one of Vietnam’s oldest villages. Walk through narrow alleys lined with laterite houses, visit ancient temples and the village gate, and experience the slow and peaceful rhythm of rural life.

15:30 – Return to Hanoi

Relax in your private car as we drive you back to your hotel or original pick-up point.

Why Choose This Tour?

  • Private and comfortable transportation

  • Friendly, experienced English-speaking guide

  • A rich blend of culture, history, architecture, and village life

  • Authentic Vietnamese cuisine

  • Excellent opportunities for photography and cultural immersion

Tour Includes

  • Private car with driver

  • English-speaking guide

  • Lunch at Duong Lam Ancient Village

  • All entrance fees

Tour Price

68 USD per person

Vietlook Travel is committed to bringing you meaningful and memorable travel experiences. This day trip offers an ideal mix of discovery, comfort, and authentic cultural encounters.
outline: Day 1: Ha Noi Cultural Day Trip
